calls.video_title: Should Investors Buy Iren Instead of Applied Digital? | IREN Stock vs. APLD Stock
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated - both IREN and APLD ranked buying opportunities (upgraded a couple of weeks ago); if forced to pick one today he would rather buy IREN, but it is a close call. Not a flip: prior tracked BUY on 2026-10-16 at $30.56 with the same $46 DCF.
calls.base_case: Cash/short-term investments $7.6bn vs long-term debt $7.84bn - better cash position than APLD; forward P/S 1.3, lowest in years; trailing revenue $707m with multi-billion backlogs.
calls.bull_case: Explosive revenue growth expected to persist as data centres are built against waiting demand.
calls.bear_case: -54% operating margin and worsening; one of the riskiest stocks in the market, extremely volatile, only for very high risk tolerance; renewal / supply-glut risk when contracts expire.

calls.video_title: Is IREN an Undervalued AI Stock to Buy Right Now?
calls.thesis: Upgrade to BUY (stated in video, dated 14 Oct 2026), low conviction: down ~33% since his 14 Sep 'not a buying opportunity' ranking at ~$45; even with a 10-20% margin of safety (up from usual 5-10%) and sharply lower FCF estimates, DCF $46 vs $30.56 looks ~50% undervalued. First tracked Parkevtate IREN call in calls.json — upgrade is vs his own prior ranking stated in the video, not a tracked flip.
calls.base_case: Cash/short-term investments ~$7.6bn vs long-term debt ~$7.8bn — one of the better neocloud balance sheets; 3-yr contract prices +~125% since Nov 2025; $6.5bn GPU financing secured, customer prepayments funding 45-55% of GPU capex.
calls.bull_case: Supply-short AI compute demand keeps pricing rising; FCF turns positive in 2030 (~$3.5bn est.) then grows rapidly.
calls.bear_case: Huge negative FCF ahead — est. -$21bn FY27, -$18bn FY28, -$17bn FY29 on raised capex; WACC 16.2% (after-tax cost of debt 12.5%); low conviction stated.
